data.one_liner: Package for authoring build_runner compatible code generators.
data.what_it_does: A package for writing code generators, called builders, that run with build_runner. It defines the core Builder interface and build step APIs for reading, analyzing, and writing files.
use_when: You are developing a custom build_runner compatible code generator package.
You need to implement the low-level Builder interface to generate code based on inputs.
avoid_when: You are just writing a standard application or package that uses existing code generators rather than authoring one.
You want a higher-level helper for annotation-based builders (use source_gen instead).
strengths: Provides the core underlying Builder interface used across the Dart build ecosystem.
Gives easy access to the analyzer for processing and resolving Dart source code.
weaknesses: Low-level compared to source_gen, requiring more manual handling of build steps.
Major version updates can introduce breaking changes for packages implementing BuildStep.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuration with build_runner to run builders.
